name: Runware
desc: Runware.AI is a high-performance, cost-effective AI media generation API specializing in images and videos. Through this integration, workflows can automatically generate visuals via text or image prompts and interact with Runware’s full-featured API.

actions.name: generateImagesFromText
actions.description: Produce images from a text description.

actions.name: generateImagesFromExistingImage
actions.description: Generate new images based on a provided image (image-to-image).
